title: Muryar Kafin Guguwa
intro: Wani mutum a cikin hamada ya tashi don ya dawo da wata ƙasa mai ƙarfi ga gaskiya. An san mutanen da gine-ginensu masu ban mamaki da ƙarfinsu mara misaltuwa. Duk da haka girman kansu ya makantar da su, kuma suka ƙi saurara. Daga ƙarshe, wata mummunar azaba ta same su, ta bar ƙaramin rukuni na masu bi kawai.
clues: An aika ni zuwa ga wani babban mutum wanda ke zaune a cikin ƙasa mai faɗi kuma an san shi da ƙarfinsa.
Mutanena sun biyo bayan wata babbar al'umma da aka lalata.
Suna da gine-gine masu kyau kuma sun gina hasumiyai masu tsayi.
Na kira su su bauta wa Allah ɗaya, amma suka ƙi barin gumakansu.
Azaba mai tsanani ta same su, sai waɗanda suka yi imani da ni kawai suka tsira.
Ni ne wanda aka aiko zuwa ga wani babban mutane da aka sani da Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
